Classic,NES™; Cheats: Adventure Island II Cheats For NES
When you're at the title screen, press the following buttons in this order:
Right, Left, Right, Left, A, B, A, B
You will then be able to choose which Island you want to play on in this new ''World Select'' menu. Use A to confirm.

Locate the fifth skull in the very first cave in the game. Once you've pass it, jump around to find a new hidden room. You'll find a bee. At any Game Over screen from now on, hold LEFT. Then press START. You will continue regularly with all the items you had before.
